Course-only authored references are captured separately, so source/applicability mismatches cannot disappear without disclosure.
targetFiltering.supportScope: Retain all explicitly collected prerequisiteOnly roles in the structural graph, as backend LearnerService9790–9808 does; do not turn a support goal into an LK completion duty or remove it merely because its global tags differ.
targetFiltering.ordinaryConsumers: Exactly authoritative SEM curricularAtomic with canonical contains empty AND effective target membership.
targetFiltering.direct: Only the consumer whole requires, not inherited ancestor-cluster requirements.
targetFiltering.transitive: Canonical requires closure from effective ordinary targets across all SEM kinds; missing IDs have neither effective target nor explicit support role. It is diagnostic, not a statement that every transitive item immediately blocks the start goal.
targetFiltering.noAutomaticWaiver: Source/excluded flags, phase or history are recorded context only, not a role exemption.
